explanation: LandingHub adds a third hero card for the macaque snRNA-seq atlas (HUB_ATLAS_ID) beside the library and expression survey cards: the card opens #/dataset/macaque_snrna and a sibling button opens its population Compare view through datasetHref and COMPARE_TRACK. The card is omitted when the registry lacks the atlas; hub CSS lays the cards out in three columns above 768px.
